component.name: Empire Labs Agent
component.description: Empire Labs' governed agent runtime. Holds the workload identity spiffe://empirelabs.com.au/agent/empire-labs-agent/capture and produces TRACE v0.2 trust records whose tool transcripts are bound to an mcp-evidence-validator evidence ledger head.

components.author: DeepSeek
components.name: deepseek-flash
components.description: Hosted inference model serving as the reasoning engine inside the Empire Labs Agent. Operated under Empire Labs' account; weights are the supplier's and are not held by Empire Labs, so no weights digest is claimed for this deployment.

technicalLimitations: Hosted inference: the exact served weights are the supplier's and are not measured by this deployment. TRACE runtime.measurement therefore records the software workload configuration under Empire Labs' control, and runtime.platform is software-only.

components.author: Empire Labs Pty Ltd
components.name: mcp-evidence-validator
components.description: Declared-vs-observed MCP contract checks over a tamper-evident SHA-256 evidence ledger. Produced the ledger head the TRACE tool_transcript binds to.
